== KDE PowerDevil settings (powerdevilrc)

  tool: kreadconfig6
  file: powerdevilrc
  AC.PowerButtonAction                   = 1
  AC.LidAction                           = 1
  AC.AutoSuspend                         = false
  AC.AutoSuspendAction                   = 0
  Battery.PowerButtonAction              = 1
  Battery.LidAction                      = 1
  Battery.AutoSuspend                    = false
  Battery.AutoSuspendAction              = 0
  note: Plasma 6 stores these keys in [AC][SuspendAndShutdown] /
        [Battery][SuspendAndShutdown]; AutoSuspendAction is a timeout in
        seconds (0 = never), not an action.
  note: kreadconfig reads the config of the user this collector runs as;
        the excerpt below is from ~/.config/powerdevilrc.

== ~/.config/powerdevilrc

  path    : ~/.config/powerdevilrc
  exists  : yes
  excerpt : first 10 line(s)
  --- begin ~/.config/powerdevilrc ---
    [AC][SuspendAndShutdown]
    PowerButtonAction=1
    LidAction=1
    AutoSuspend=false
    AutoSuspendAction=0
    [Battery][SuspendAndShutdown]
    PowerButtonAction=1
    LidAction=1
    AutoSuspend=false
    AutoSuspendAction=0
  --- end ~/.config/powerdevilrc ---
